summary: Enforce scan-time scope on watch roots in scan_once: reject a root whose stored path has become a symlink, and re-verify the resolved root is within a configured SAGE_WATCH_DIRS base before walking.
final_report: T21 fixes the round-3 Warden finding on feature/latex-notes as 3056818. Root cause: scan_once (app/services/watcher.py) resolved the stored watch root and walked it with no containment re-check, so a watch root directory replaced on disk by a symlink (local write access to a watch root) resolved outside SAGE_WATCH_DIRS and os.walk would ingest arbitrary server-readable files. Fix in scan_once right after resolved_root = root.resolve(): (a) if Path(row['path']).is_symlink() the source is rejected with summary errors += 1 and the warning 'watch root is a symlink: {root}', returning via the existing _finish_scan error shape (no walk); (b) when settings.watch_dirs is non-empty, resolved_root is re-verified against each resolved base using os.path.commonpath containment with the same semantics as _resolve_in_scope in app/api/watch.py (skipping filesystem-root bases, ValueError-tolerant), and if out of scope the source is rejected with errors += 1, the warning 'watch root is outside the configured watch directories: {resolved_root}', and no walk. Both rejections persist last_error through _finish_scan. API boundary and everything else untouched. Test added in tests/test_watcher.py (test_scan_rejects_root_swapped_for_out_of_scope_symlink): a watch source is added and scanned over a real directory, then the directory is rmtree'd and replaced on disk by a directory symlink to a directory outside the configured base containing a leaked.tex; the second scan_once ingests nothing from the target (added == 0, the only files row is the original calc.tex), errors == 1, the warning matches 'symlink' or 'outside the configured watch directories', and last_error is persisted on the watch_sources row. The test executes on this host (symlink creation works); the OSError skip guard is retained for hosts that deny symlinks. Verification (laika): full offline suite `python -m pytest -q` → 297 passed in 30.50s (296 prior + 1 new); the new test passes standalone. Line counts raw wc -l semantics via git cat-file LF-byte counting (no wc binary on host): watcher.py 237 -> 263, test_watcher.py 717 -> 759. No concurrent writers; base_commit re-checked before finalize (only the declared files changed between base_commit and commit).
notes: Round-3 Warden finding (scan-time symlink swap out of configured bases) fixed with two guards: an add-time stored path is always canonical, so a symlink there can only be a swap; the containment re-check is defense in depth for any residual resolution drift. Mirrors _resolve_in_scope containment semantics in app/api/watch.py. `wc` is absent on this host, so line counts were computed as LF-byte counts from `git cat-file blob` via .NET, matching `git show HEAD:<path> | wc -l` semantics.
